# Shringar Makeup Academy

> Shringar Makeup Academy in Hyderabad offers hands-on Professional Makeup Artist, Skin Care / Beauty Therapy and Cosmetology courses with lifetime support, business guidance and professional certification. Morning (10 AM-1 PM) and afternoon (2 PM-5 PM) sessions near Dilsukhnagar Metro Station.

## Courses

- [Professional Makeup Artist Course (Rs. 20,000)](https://shringaracademy.in/#courses): 30-day intensive, basic to bridal makeover, 15+ hairstyles, 5 saree draping styles, guided until first client.
- [Skin Care / Beauty Therapy Course (Rs. 20,000)](https://shringaracademy.in/#courses): waxing and threading, basic and advanced facials, HydraFacial and de-tan, manicure, pedicure and spa care.
- [Cosmetology Course (Rs. 40,000)](https://shringaracademy.in/#courses): complete program combining makeup, skin care, nail art, flower making and airbrush makeup.
- [Makeup + Skin Combined Course (Rs. 30,000)](https://shringaracademy.in/#courses): both career skills in one batch with 100% placement support; saves Rs. 10,000 versus the separate course fees.

## Admissions

- [Enquire about admissions](https://shringaracademy.in/#contact): admissions open; call +91 63040 71731 or send an enquiry on WhatsApp.
- [Upcoming batches](https://shringaracademy.in/#batches): new batches start regularly with limited seats per batch.

## Visit

- Location: Opposite Konark Theater, Near Dilsukhnagar Metro Station, Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
- Phone: +91 63040 71731.
